package.description: Highly-affordable, high-performance automation of any-to-any data conversion, integration, & ETL processes

en-US.description: Highly-affordable, high-performance automation of any-to-any data conversion, integration, & ETL processes
en-US.longDescription:
MapForce Server automates data transformations for any combination of XML, JSON, database, EDI, XBRL, flat file, Excel, and/or Web service based on optimized data mappings.
The advanced edition contains support for NoSQL databases as well as several high-performance optimizations, including multi-threading of execution of multiple different data mappings, optimization for execution of the MapForce join component, and processing mappings with node functions for the fastest throughput for high-performance server platforms.
Note: must be installed on a machine with at least 2 CPU cores available.
en-US.name: Altova MapForce Server Advanced Edition

zh-CN.description: 以极高性价比实现高性能的任意格式数据转换、集成与 ETL 流程自动化
zh-CN.longDescription:
MapForce Server 可基于优化的数据映射，自动执行任意组合的 XML、JSON、数据库、EDI、XBRL、平面文件、Excel 和/或 Web 服务之间的数据转换。
高级版本额外支持 NoSQL 数据库，并包含多项高性能优化功能：支持多线程执行不同数据映射、优化 MapForce 连接组件的执行效率，以及通过节点函数处理映射，从而为高性能服务器平台提供极致吞吐量。
注意：需安装在至少配备 2 个 CPU 核心的设备上。
